queries.name: original_records
queries.title: Complete original geothermal records
queries.note: Every original source row and column, including explicit nulls, source URLs and original attribution.

queries.name: selected_country
queries.title: Selected country and capacity threshold
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM {{plants}} WHERE {{column:country}} = ? AND {{column:capacity_mw}} >= ? ORDER BY {{column:capacity_mw}} DESC, {{column:gppd_idnr}}
queries.note: Country is the original three-letter code. The capacity threshold uses the published capacity_mw field in MW.

queries.name: country_inventory
queries.title: Country capacity and 2017 generation coverage
queries.sql: SELECT {{column:country}} AS country, {{column:country_long}} AS country_name, COUNT(*) AS plants, SUM({{column:capacity_mw}}) AS published_capacity_mw, COUNT({{column:year_of_capacity_data}}) AS plants_with_capacity_year, COUNT({{column:generation_gwh_2017}}) AS plants_with_observed_generation_2017, SUM({{column:generation_gwh_2017}}) AS observed_generation_2017_gwh FROM {{plants}} GROUP BY {{column:country}}, {{column:country_long}} ORDER BY {{column:country}}
queries.note: Capacity MW and observed generation GWh retain separate units. SUM ignores missing observations and remains NULL when every observation is missing; the coverage count accompanies the total.

queries.name: source_quality
queries.title: Reviewed source coverage
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT {{column:gppd_idnr}}) AS distinct_plant_keys, SUM(CASE WHEN {{column:gppd_idnr}} IS NULL OR TRIM({{column:gppd_idnr}}) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_or_blank_keys, SUM(CASE WHEN {{column:owner}} IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_owner, SUM(CASE WHEN {{column:year_of_capacity_data}} IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_capacity_year, SUM(CASE WHEN {{column:generation_gwh_2017}} IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_observed_generation_2017, SUM(CASE WHEN {{column:latitude}} IS NULL OR {{column:longitude}} IS NULL OR {{column:latitude}} < -90 OR {{column:latitude}} > 90 OR {{column:longitude}} < -180 OR {{column:longitude}} > 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_or_out_of_range_coordinates FROM {{plants}}
queries.note: Source-quality counts retain each underlying record in the complete original-records output.

report.title: WRI geothermal source inventory and selected-country review
report.introduction: World Resources Institute, Global Power Plant Database, CC BY 4.0. Source pages were observed on 12 October 2026; capacity, commissioning and generation values retain their original historical source years. This report separates published capacity in MW, observed 2017 generation in GWh, estimated generation and missing observations.
report.note: Complete original edition, customer SQL, parameters, report and editable workspace delivered together.
